verdict.rationale: Cloudflare explicitly claims Workers fits existing Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code and any-framework workflows, and lists support for React, Vue, Svelte, Next, Astro and more. However, creating, developing and deploying Workers relies on Cloudflare's own Wrangler CLI (open source in workers-sdk) and its create-cloudflare scaffolder, so some vendor-specific tooling is still adopted. One hands-on report notes a local linter flagging Python Workers' runtime-only libraries as unknown. missing for 10: documented Git/CI integration details beyond a marketing line, a deploy path that avoids Wrangler, independent corroboration of editor/CI workflow compatibility.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep using my existing Git, CI, editor, and framework workflows without adopting proprietary tooling
